source: 03b §8 (the stages and the lengths per chem RULED 11-16); 04 and 04c (RadAway, Rad-X, painkillers); Fallout 2's code

rows.name: Caffeine
rows.source: 04j §7a (RULED 11-27): the sleep stage shown one better (an adenosine blocker masks the pressure, the debt stays), none for a daily user (tolerant: in its own dependence); withdrawal: headache, fatigue, poor concentration from 12-24 h, in about half of regular users (Juliano & Griffiths 2004, a review); the 10 % a day and the -1 Intelligence [mine]; lengths RULED (03b §8)

rows.name: Alcohol
rows.source: Fallout 2's beer (-1 Perception, no hangover); 1 h = a drink cleared (the liver ~1 a hour); Pain -10 (04c); 5 % a drink as New Vegas (Fallout 2 20 %, Fallout 4 15-25 %; our 7-day count raises it with every drink); the addiction -1 Agility -1 Charisma (New Vegas and Fallout 4 alike); lengths RULED; colder in the cold (04g §5, RULED): the cold bar's gain x1.5 for its hour [the 0.5 mine]; 04i §6b (RULED 11-27): a diuretic, the water need +25 % for 6 h a drink (its hour and 5 after), a depressant (with an opioid: the breathing stage)

rows.name: Nicotine
rows.source: attention and reaction time better (Heishman et al. 2010, a meta-analysis); the most addictive of the common drugs: 32 % of those who ever smoke become dependent, twice alcohol's 15 % (Anthony, Warner & Kessler 1994); the withdrawal irritable and unfocused (DSM-5); lengths RULED

rows.name: Codeine
rows.source: 04c §4b (-20 for 6 h, 3 % a day); the withdrawal half of morphine's; the painkillers' lengths RULED (03b §8)

rows.name: Morphine
rows.source: 04c §4b (Fallout's Med-X: -40 for 4 h, 10 % a day); the addiction -1 Agility -1 Intelligence = Med-X's in New Vegas; lengths RULED

rows.name: Ketamine
rows.source: 04c §4b (-50 for 1 h, Intelligence -2 an hour on waking)

rows.name: Metamizole
rows.source: 04i §3b: Novalgin, Algifen, the Czech hospitals' strong painkiller; no breathing slowed; the bone marrow fails once in about 1 000 courses (the GM's) [real]; -25 for 6 h [mine]

rows.name: Aspirin
rows.source: 04i §3b: Acylpyrin, Czech since the 1950s; as ibuprofen (04c §4b: -15 for 6 h, thins the blood: Bleeding +1, RULED)

rows.name: Tramadol
rows.source: 04i §3b: as codeine (04c §4b: -20 for 6 h, 3 % a day); no runs halved [real: less constipating]

rows.name: Methadone
rows.source: 04i §3b: the Czech substitution programmes' drug [real]: a day's dose turns an opioid's withdrawal into its dependence; itself an opioid (its own longer withdrawal) [the numbers mine]

rows.name: Pervitin
rows.source: 04i §3c: the raiders' and Pirates' home-cooked stimulant, the Czech word for methamphetamine since the 1940s [real]; made by the kitchen's recipe or from ephedra (04j §7e, RULED 11-27); the numbers mine, EXAMPLE (amphetamine's, stronger and longer); the sleep stage shown two better, water +25 %, heat +1 an hour at work (04j §7a, 04i §6b, RULED 11-27)

rows.name: Paracetamol
rows.source: 04c §4b (-10 for 6 h; the liver if overdosed: the GM's)

rows.name: Ibuprofen
rows.source: 04c §4b (ibuprofen or aspirin, -15 for 6 h; thins the blood: Bleeding +1 while it works, RULED round 7, built 04i)

rows.name: Willow bark
rows.source: 04c §5 (willow-bark tea or extract, -10 for 6 h; Cochrane: 240 mg salicin a day eased back pain)

rows.name: Opium
rows.source: 04c §5 (the Czech poppy: -30 for 6 h, the runs' water loss halved, 10 % a day of use); the addiction as morphine's

rows.name: Cannabis
rows.source: 04c §5 (nausea and pain -10; ~9 % of users become dependent [approx]; the 2 % a day and the lengths mine)

rows.name: Herbal tea
rows.source: 04c §5 (linden, elderflower, chamomile: comfort, the placebo's -5)

rows.name: Tannin tea
rows.source: 04c §5 (oak bark, dried blueberries, black tea: the runs' water loss -0.5 an hour; weak, traditional)

rows.name: Placebo
rows.source: 04c §6 (RULED round 7: anything believed in, Pain -5 for the scene; nothing else)

rows.name: Diazepam
rows.source: 04c §4b (tetanus's spasms x0.8 with the dark room; with opioids the breathing stops: the GM's); dependence [approx]

rows.name: Amphetamine
rows.source: 11 % of users become dependent (Anthony et al. 1994, stimulants other than cocaine); 4-6 h awake and quicker; the crash and withdrawal: fatigue and low mood (their numbers [mine], set like Buffout's crash); lengths RULED

rows.name: Buffout
rows.source: Fallout 2 (fallout.wiki; the addiction's -2 S -2 E -3 A from its engine's perk table); lengths RULED; 04i §6a (RULED 11-27): a fast androgen and a stimulant: food need +50 %, heat +1 an hour at work

rows.name: Mentats
rows.source: Fallout 2 (fallout.wiki: a day, then -2/-2/-2 for 4 days; the addiction -3 I -2 A from the engine); lengths RULED; 04i §6a (RULED 11-27): a wakefulness drug, the sleep debt x1.5 while it works, no stage better (04j §7a)

rows.name: Psycho
rows.source: Fallout 2 (fallout.wiki: 4 h, then -2 I for 8 h; the addiction -2 I from the engine); lengths RULED; 04i §6a, 04j §7 (RULED 11-27): a dissociative and adrenaline: Pain felt -60, no knockdown or stun, F2's DR +50 cut to a slight +10 (Marek: "it could harden you on cellular level")

rows.name: Jet
rows.source: Fallout 2 (fallout.wiki: 5 minutes, then 24 h; 50 %; the addiction -1 AP -1 S -1 P from the engine, until the antidote); lengths RULED

rows.name: Jet Antidote
rows.source: Fallout 2: ends Jet's addiction

rows.name: RadAway
rows.source: 04 (RULED 11-15/16): 50 + Medicine rads out over 4 h, 10 % a dose, -20 rad resistance for about 3 weeks; 04i §6a (RULED 11-27): a chelator and a flush, the water need +50 % for its hours, Endurance -1 for a day after (it strips zinc too)

rows.name: Rad-X
rows.source: 04 (RULED: as Fallout 2): +50 % rad resistance for 24 h, then +25 % for 48 h; 04i §6a (RULED 11-27): an oral radioprotector, it brings up the stomach (Food -10 at once) [the 10 mine]

rows.name: Prussian blue
rows.source: 09e round 2: the lower RadAway, (50 + Medicine) / 2 rads out over 3 days, no addiction [numbers mine, EXAMPLE]

rows.name: Tacrolimus
rows.source: 09e §6: the pre-war anti-rejection tablets, a month's course; Immunity -30 % [numbers mine, EXAMPLE]

rows.name: Azathioprine
rows.source: 09e round 2: the made anti-rejection drug (Chems III R2), a month's course, the worse rejection rate [numbers mine, EXAMPLE]

rows.name: Fixer
rows.source: New Vegas's Fixer, made real (04i §6a): a withdrawal blocker for every chem (methadone or buprenorphine do it for opioids today, clonidine eases it [real]): every withdrawal's penalties off for 24 h, the dependence stays

rows.name: Hydra
rows.source: New Vegas's Hydra, made real (04i §6a): bone growth factors and a bone glue (rhBMP-2 today, bone glues in trials [real]): a crippled limb (a broken leg) mends when its 3 days end; New Vegas's addiction dropped

rows.name: Cateye
rows.source: New Vegas's Cateye, made real (04i §6a): eye drops that sensitise the retina (chlorin e6, tried in 2015, unproven [real]): the dark halved for 4 h; a flash or the sun: Perception -2 that hour (the GM's)

rows.name: Steady
rows.source: 04j §7d (RULED 11-27: *"Tier IV Steady - yes."*): a 2040s motor-control drug quieting the tremor circuit (deep-brain stimulation does it for tremor today [real]): +15 to hit on an aimed shot for 6 h, none of propranolol's costs; 10 % addiction (the calm is pleasant): the withdrawal a tremor, aimed -10 for 2 weeks [mine]

rows.name: Propranolol
rows.source: 04i §6a (RULED 11-27, Marek: *"Steady - good idea with propranolol."*): a beta-blocker, marksmen's against tremor, banned in Olympic shooting [real]: +10 to hit on an aimed shot for 6 h, AP -1 (the heart cannot race), cold hands (+0.5 an hour); no addiction; stopped after a week of daily doses: AP -1 for a day (the rebound)

rows.name: Naloxone
rows.source: 04i §6c (RULED 11-27): the opioid antidote [real]: ends the breathing stage at once, and the opioids' effect with it

rows.name: Activated charcoal
rows.source: 04i §6c (RULED 11-27): Carbo medicinalis, the pharmacies' [real]: a swallowed poison's uptake halved in its hour (04g §5)

rows.name: Pseudoephedrine
rows.source: 04j §7e (RULED 11-27, Marek: *"T3 chem (pseudoefedrin from common flu medicine)"*): the flu tablets' decongestant (a stuffy nose eased: the GM's); the pervitin kitchen's precursor

rows.name: Valerian
rows.source: 04i §6c (RULED 11-27): kozlík, a folk sleep aid (weak): asleep at once, the first hour of rest counts (Pain does not keep you up)

rows.name: Hops
rows.source: 04i §6c (RULED 11-27): chmel, Czech hops everywhere, a folk sleep aid (weak): as valerian

rows.name: Herbal bitters
rows.source: 04i §6c (RULED 11-27): a Czech herbal liqueur: nausea off for 2 h; it is alcohol (its addiction, cold and thirst)

rows.name: Absinthe
rows.source: 04i §6c (RULED 11-27): wormwood spirit, Czech-made today [real]: nausea off for 2 h; it is alcohol

rows.name: Hydrotab
rows.source: 04j §7c: the kidney's water kept (vasopressin analogues, desmopressin today [real]): the water need -50 % for 24 h, +25 % the next day

rows.name: Torpor
rows.source: 04j §7c: hibernation research (hydrogen sulphide in mice, NASA's torpor for Mars [real]): food and water needs x0.5 for 24 h; AP -2, Agility -1; the cold's gain +25 %

rows.name: Nightcap
rows.source: 04j §7c: deeper sleep (sodium oxybate deepens slow-wave sleep today [real]): 4 hours of unbroken sleep count as 8

rows.name: Antidote
rows.source: Fallout 2's Antidote, 04j §7c: nanosponges that soak up toxins (since 2013 [real]): Poison -75 at once (F2's)

rows.name: Furnace
rows.source: 04j §7c: brown fat switched on (mirabegron does a little today [real]): the cold's gain halved for 6 h; food need +50 %

rows.name: Coolant
rows.source: 04j §7c: heat-shock proteins primed [the path mine]: the heat's gain halved for 6 h; water need +25 %

rows.name: Numb
rows.source: 04j §7c: a sodium-channel painkiller (the first, suzetrigine, approved in 2025 [real]): Pain felt -40 for 8 h; no addiction, no breathing slowed, no sedation

rows.name: O-Shot
rows.source: 04j §7c: oxygen microparticles injected (kept animals alive 15 minutes without breathing, 2012 [real]): the Oxygen bar full and 10 more rounds of breath, once
